fixture.summary: A 12-line duration parser in a throwaway local git repository, small enough that one implementer and one QA role finish within the deadline and the whole fixture fits in a context window.
fixture.pin_basis: the build is reproducible (fixed files, author, dates and message), and a test rebuilds it and checks this hash
fixture.task: Extend parseDuration in src/duration.mjs to accept compound durations written largest unit first ("1h30m", "2m30s", "1h1m1s") and the ISO-8601 time form ("PT1H30M", "PT45S", "PT2H"), keeping every current behaviour. Add tests for what you add as new files in test/added/ (named *.check.mjs). The files directly in test/ are the existing tests: do not edit them.
out_of_bounds: every file directly in test/ (the existing tests); only new files in test/added/ are allowed there
fixture.hidden_acceptance: tests/eval/org/fixtures/dev-feature-qa/hidden/acceptance.check.mjs, copied into test/ by the harness only at verification; never present in a role's workspace
fixture.solvability_check: a reference solution under hidden/reference passes both the repository's tests and the hidden acceptance tests (checked by fixture.test.ts)

changes.what: Added test/added/ (a README, so git keeps it) as the place for new tests, widened the test glob to test/**/*.check.mjs, and reworded the task and out-of-bounds rule to name that place. The template's test files and the hidden acceptance tests are unchanged.
changes.why: In the first smoke run both contenders added their tests to the existing test file, which the checker treats as out of bounds; the template had a single test file and nowhere else to put new tests.
